name: Dig out of Prison

analytics, tracking, accounts, cloud saves, source leaderboards, and external URLs
localAdaptations: network-lock is the first executable script
the exact CrazyGames SDK v3 script is packaged locally and runs only in its documented localhost mode behind the shared network lock
a guarded in-memory compatibility patch applies only to this audited Wasm build's exact host-lock and Unity quit functions; the source payload on disk is unchanged
the intro remains visible but its tap-to-continue coroutine auto-advances on first play
the source payload is retained as equivalent local Brotli-compressed runtime files with explicit same-origin MIME and Content-Encoding delivery
the original Unity launcher starts immediately when the card is mounted
mobile fallback controls map every source-documented WASD, Space, mouse, E, X, and Q command without remote services
limitations: No completed local score run has yet been verified for ranking, so this game is intentionally unranked.
A cold Unity payload cannot be literally instant; Tip Tap warms only the next card's audited critical path and browser caching makes repeat plays fast.
Public GitHub and Replit redistribution remains subject to the rights holder permission represented by the project owner.
